mapper.select: SELECT category_name FROM categories ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT t.topic_id AS id, c.category_name AS category, t.title, t.difficulty, t.duration_min, t.duration_max, t.guide_text AS guide, 0 AS favorite FROM topics t INNER JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = t.category_id WHERE t.topic_id = #{topicId}
